name: Staple Port
description: This [location|e] has been granted legal privileges giving the [ShowEstateTypeName('burghers_estate')] more rights over the local [trade|e].

name: Granary Town
description: This [location|e] has been granted legal privileges and regulations to increase its production and storage of [food|e].

name: Market Charter
description: This [location|e] has been granted the right to hold regular markets, drawing merchants and traders and expanding the capacity of its local [ShowBuildingTypeName('marketplace')].

name: Free Town Charter
description: This [location|e] has been granted rights of self-governance, reducing direct [ShowEstateTypeName('crown_estate')] authority in exchange for greater freedom to attract settlers and conduct trade.

name: Fortress Town
description: This [location|e] has been designated a military garrison, receiving investment in its fortifications and [manpower|e]. The permanent military presence crowds out civilian commerce.

name: Mining Charter
description: This [location|e] has been granted formal rights to conduct and expand mining operations, increasing the scale of extraction. The [ShowEstateTypeName('peasants_estate')] are subject to stricter obligations as a result.

name: Studium Privileges
description: This [location|e] has been recognized as a center of learning, granting it the right to maintain schools and attract scholars. Such pursuits advance [literacy|e] and [institution|e] spread, though they rarely enrich the treasury directly.

name: Tooling Rights
description: This [location|e] has been granted legal privileges over the production and distribution of [ShowGoodsName('tools')], conferring a significant competitive advantage.

name: Jewelry Rights
description: This [location|e] has been granted legal privileges over the production and distribution of [ShowGoodsName('jewelry')], conferring a significant competitive advantage.

name: Naval Supplies Rights
description: This [location|e] has been granted legal privileges over the production and distribution of [ShowGoodsName('naval_supplies')] and [ShowGoodsName('tar')], conferring a significant competitive advantage.

name: Textile Rights
description: This [location|e] has been granted legal privileges over the production and distribution of [ShowGoodsName('cloth')] and [ShowGoodsName('fine_cloth')], conferring a significant competitive advantage.

name: Weaponry Rights
description: This [location|e] has been granted legal privileges over the production and distribution of [ShowGoodsName('weaponry')], [ShowGoodsName('firearms')], and [ShowGoodsName('cannons')], conferring a significant competitive advantage.

name: Printing Rights
description: This [location|e] has been granted legal privileges over the production and distribution of [ShowGoodsName('paper')], [ShowGoodsName('books')], and [ShowGoodsName('dyes')], conferring a significant competitive advantage.

name: Artisan Rights
description: This [location|e] has been granted legal privileges over the production and distribution of [ShowGoodsName('leather')], [ShowGoodsName('pottery')], and [ShowGoodsName('furniture')], conferring a significant competitive advantage.

name: Spirituous Rights
description: This [location|e] has been granted legal privileges over the production and distribution of [ShowGoodsName('liquor')], [ShowGoodsName('beer')], and [ShowGoodsName('wine')], conferring a significant competitive advantage.

name: Masonry Rights
description: This [location|e] has been granted legal privileges over the production and distribution of [ShowGoodsName('masonry')] and [ShowGoodsName('glass')], conferring a significant competitive advantage.

name: Royal Free City Rights
description: By declaring our urban centers as Royal and Free Cities we can prevent our [ShowEstateTypeName('nobles_estate')] from accumulating power within their bounds.

name: Royal City Rights
description: Granting cities the privilege of being declared direct property of our ruler will weaken the [ShowEstateTypeName('nobles_estate')], and could help our state extract more value from them directly.

name: Stadsrättigheter Rights
description: The merchants of this location will receive extended privileges to conduct their trade free of foreign competition.

name: Kjøpstad Rights
description: Granting privileges to the merchants of this location and giving them preferential treatment will bolster our own trading routes, while disfavoring foreign merchants.

name: Flemish Cloth Industry
description: The Late Middle Ages saw the birth of a powerful textile industry in the Low Countries. Manufactured from imported $ENG_ADJ$ and $CAS_ADJ$ wool, fabric of the highest quality were exported to all of $europe$.

name: Ville Franche Rights
description: $villes_franches_desc$

name: Borgo Franco Rights
description: The spread of communes throughout $italy_region$ is a reality, forming the backbone of the region. These are often considered #italic Borgo Franco#! (free towns) and enjoy many special privileges compared to the countryside.

name: Charter of Religious Freedom
description: This [location|e] has received special rights, recognizing the religious freedom of every individual person in exchange for providing large parts of its territory for the production of food and raw materials.

name: Commoner Council Rights
description: This [location|e] has been granted the right to open their local council to commoners. This grants the peasantry a voice in local affairs and allows them to request greater rights for themselves.

name: Fiskeriprivilegier
description: This [location|e] has been granted exclusive rights over nearby fishing grounds and the trade in dried and salted fish. Norwegian coastal towns organized around these privileges supplied [ShowGoodsName('fish')] across Northern Europe.

name: Bergslagsprivilegier
description: The Crown has recognized this [location|e] as a mining community (bergslag), granting it collective rights over local ore extraction, its own court, and freedom from military conscription. The [ShowEstateTypeName('peasants_estate')] of the mines hold a stronger legal standing than in ordinary towns.

name: Tjärprivilegier
description: This [location|e] has been granted rights to harvest and export [ShowGoodsName('tar')] and [ShowGoodsName('naval_supplies')] from Crown forests. These forest industries are the backbone of Baltic shipbuilding supply chains.

name: Tingsrätt
description: This [location|e] has been granted formal assembly rights (tingsrätt), giving its inhabitants a recognized legal forum for governance and justice. Royal authority is curtailed in exchange for a more orderly and loyal population.

name: $magdeburg_rights$
description: $magdeburg_rights_desc$

name: [ShowLocationNameWithNoTooltip('lubeck')] Rights
description: Regulating the laws and privileges within our urban settlements according to those of [ShowLocationName('lubeck')] itself will grant our merchants more power. While the benefits for our traders will assist their abilities to conduct trade, the guild members within the city will be unhappy about this preferential treatment and obstruct us in their own ways.

name: [ShowLocationNameWithNoTooltip('nuremberg')] Rights
description: $magdeburg_rights_town_rights_desc$

name: Upper Bergregal
description: Ceding the right to conduct mining operations to the government of the town will increase the funds available to prospect for more minerals, and increase the appeal to potential new settlers. Unfortunately, this comes at the cost of sharper restrictions on the local commoners and their ability to benefit from the mines themselves.

name: Lower Bergregal
description: $upper_bergregal_desc$

name: [ShowSpecialStatusNameWithNoTooltip('free_city')] Staple Rights
description: The title of a [ShowSpecialStatusName('free_city')] granted to us by the [ShowSpecialStatusName('emperor')] grants us the freedom to enact certain privileges within our cities, benefiting the local merchants and forcing more foreign merchants to trade through our lands.

name: Kulm Rights
description: $kulm_law_desc$

name: $novi_fori$ Rights
description: $novi_fori_desc$

name: Borough Custumals
description: The locations bestowed with these rights will be able to administrate their own growth and serve as free havens from noble oppression.

name: Manorial Custumals
description: Granting the manorial landholders more executive power over this location will increase the exploitation of the land and keep the unruly peasantry in check.

name: Foros Extensos
description: Since its inception, $POR$ has been a borderland, populated by renowned men such as Geraldo sem Pavor. Its rulers encourage this bravery and indomitability by granting wide concessions usually known as $foros_extensos_town_rights$.

name: Fuero Juzgo
description: The $fuero_juzgo_town_rights$ is based on the ancient Visigothic code, the #italic Liber Iudiciorum#!. As such, it regulates many aspects of daily life, making it especially appropriate for newly colonized lands.

name: Fuero Real
description: The $fuero_real_town_rights$ is a code devised by King Alfonso X of Castile to extend royal power throughout the municipalities of $CAS$.

name: Fuero General
description: The $fuero_general_town_rights$ of $NAV$ is the compilation of customs and laws that govern the different estates of the territory, in agreement with its ruler.

name: Fueros de Aragón
description: The $fuero_de_aragon_town_rights$ compiled the various municipal rights that spread throughout $aragon_area$ during its expansion. Therefore, they are rigorously defended by both the $nobles_estate$ and the $peasants_estate$.

name: Usatges de Barcelona
description: The $usatges_de_barcelona_town_rights$ are the customs and traditions that govern the $catalan$ territories, promulgated and granted originally by the Counts of $barcelona$.

name: Furs de Valencia
description: The $furs_de_valencia_town_rights$ were granted to the kingdom of the same name by King James I of Aragon after its conquest. Their main difference from the old customs of $aragon_area$ and $catalonia_area$ lay in their focus on regulating coexistence with the $muslim_ADJ$ population, which is the majority in some areas.

name: Imperial Breadbasket
description: This [location|e] has been entrusted with provisioning the wider realm, its granaries expanded to account for our ambitious plans. Grain flows inward and outward under imperial supervision, sustaining the citizens and army alike with abundance.

name: Silk Monopoly of [ShowLocationNameWithNoTooltip('constantinople')]
description: Within [ShowLocationName('constantinople')], the production of [ShowGoodsName('silk')] is held to a high standard, a long tradition that spans generations. Workshops flourish under imperial oversight, though all production dances to the tune of monopoly.

name: Scholai Privileges
description: This [location|e] is recognized as a center of learning, where letters are fostered under official patronage. Knowledge spreads swiftly, though such pursuits rarely enrich the treasury. Idle minds are the devil's playthings.

name: Municipia Privileges
description: This [location|e] has been elevated to the status of municipium, its citizens granted rights under our law. Local elites wield greater influence, binding the land closer to the traditions of [ShowSocietyDirectionName('latinization')].
